propositions: The epic-close bug screen's per-candidate exception handler degrades all failures including LLMUnavailableError to verdict C ('unrelated'), silently blinding the caused_by bug floor when a provider outage affects all 32+ candidate evaluations
max_tokens is not re-clamped when model resolves to a smaller ceiling (haiku 64K vs sonnet 128K), causing deterministic 400 ValidationExceptions on Bedrock calls
Provider errors during completion verification currently result in PASS verdict with no attestation instead of blocking the close as intended for systematic failures
The fail-closed gate behavior for absent LLM providers must also apply to degraded providers via LLMUnavailableError propagation from both warm-call and fan-out paths
Non-systemic per-candidate failures (malformed output, store errors) must continue degrading to C to preserve documented degrade-open behavior and distinguish from provider outages
